styles.name: ISU Board
styles.description: The classic. Someone reads the clue, the teams shout, and the host awards the points.

styles.name: Multiple Choice Board
styles.description: Teams take turns picking answers. Right answers score, wrong ones cost you, and a Daily Double is hiding on the board.

styles.name: 60-Second Blitz
styles.description: Answer as many multiple-choice questions as you can in a minute. Streaks multiply your points.

styles.name: Sudden Death
styles.description: No clock to beat, but one wrong answer ends the run. How far can your streak go?

styles.name: Quick Match
styles.description: Three survey rounds between two teams. Fast, loud, and over before the pizza gets cold.

styles.name: Full Match
styles.description: Six rounds of surveys with later rounds worth more. The steal decides everything.

styles.name: Cy's Maze Run
styles.description: Steer Cy through mazes that grow every level. Grab gold, beat the timer, reach the portal.

styles.name: Watch the Solver
styles.description: Generate a maze and watch breadth-first search, depth-first search or A* race to the finish.

styles.name: Easy 4×4
styles.description: Eight campus pairs and plenty of time. A good warm-up.

styles.name: Hard 6×4 with Timer
styles.description: Twelve pairs, a ticking clock, and combo bonuses for chaining matches.
